summary: Tested ENH1 Perk Expiry + ENH2 Owner Live Scheduler on both surfaces + touched regression flow (bar-game-card). Backend 6/6 pytest pass (wallet expires_at+expired shape, seeded BAR-NEON2FOR present, active count excludes expired/redeemed, expired perk returns 400 perk_expired, owner creates scheduled show + pins product, is_owner true/false gating). WEB: /shop/biz_demo_bar shows bar-game-card with owner-only bar-game-customize + bar-game-schedule-live for demo, both HIDDEN for freeuser. Scheduler modal opens with all testids (scheduler-title/desc/when/prod-0/prod-1/add-prod/submit) — add-prod adds scheduler-prod-2, submit closes modal and creates a real scheduled liveshow (verified 'WEB TEST Neon Friday' seeded + then cleaned). /drink-perks lists 'Free Neon Mojito' with amber 'Expires in 14d' badge (perk-expiry-<id>) + Mark redeemed button; injected expired play renders red 'Expired' badge + perk-expired-<id> label INSTEAD of redeem button, card dimmed to opacity 0.6. MOBILE (Expo preview): demo-login-btn works; /bar/perks shows drink-perks-screen with 'Expires in 14d' and Mark redeemed; /bar/schedule/biz_demo_bar renders bar-schedule-screen with title/desc + all 5 preset chips (scheduler-when-1/3/6/24/48) + prod-0/1 + add-prod + submit; submit successfully creates scheduled liveshow 'MOBILE TEST Live' (verified via API, then cleaned). Parity: OK — both surfaces expose the same expiry badge + expired blocking + owner-only scheduler entry. LiveKit A/V mocked (not asserted). Sound/haptics fire silently — spin regression untouched but no console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful schedule submit, submit() calls router.back() unconditionally. When the user opens the screen via a deep link / direct URL (no navigation history), Expo Router logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'. Minor UX-only — the show IS created and persisted. Consider router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/social') and also surface a success toast so the user gets confirmation.

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Mobile BarScheduleLive: guard router.back() with router.canGoBack() and add a success toast on schedule create so users on deep-linked entries get confirmation instead of a silent GO_BACK warning.

(Optional / LOW) Web BarOwnerScheduler + DrinkPerks: after schedule submit consider auto-nudging the user to Social > Live > Upcoming (or firing a toast that links there). Currently the modal just closes.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bar_games.py still has TWO __all__ declarations at lines 336 and 389 — only the second one takes effect (harmless, flagged in iter185 and iter186; still not cleaned up).

BarGameCard.spin() (line 104) still uses the TDZ-style fallback `res.segments?.length || data?.config?.segments?.length` (not actually a TDZ since it's inside async fn body, but the `segments` local shadow declared on line 132 is unused before line 104 — code reads confusingly). Not a bug, but readability.

DrinkPerks.jsx line 33: after a successful redeem the local optimistic update decrements `active` — but does not check whether the item was already redeemed/expired locally. In practice unreachable because expired items don't render a Mark-redeemed button, but worth a guard if the wallet ever ships multi-tab sync.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all ENH1 + ENH2 selectors + owner-hidden regression verified on web and mobile)
